summary.en: Conan, Kogoro and Ran are at a Birthday party for Reika Yotsui, who is the daughter of the Yotsui group president of which Kogoro is a guest of honor. When Mr.Yotsui tries to introduce Kogoro to everyone, Kogoro unknowingly embarrasses himself in front of him. In fact, he and his family were invited to the party as a way to show gratitude for finding Reika’s dog. They meet with Takashi Ichieda, Yuji Nikaido, Takuya Mifune, Osamu Gojo and Masashi Rokuda, all of whom are Reika's friends. Conan leaves the ballroom to use the bathroom, it is there he notes that the hallway lights are off. Once he is able to find a bathroom, he tries to turn on the lights in the bathroom they do not turn on as well. He is then found by Yotsui’s housekeeper Yone Nanao and guided to one with functional lights. She also mentions how weird it was when the lights didn’t work despite being changed just a few days prior.
